With Hold Messages on, most plain text messages, contacts and static locations you send or schedule while Ghost Mode is active stay on this device. You can also switch it from the Send button\'s long-press menu. When you turn Ghost Mode or Hold Messages off, undated items go out and future-scheduled items keep their schedule. If a chat starts charging to send while one of your messages is already held, that message stays held so you can send it by hand. Photos, videos, files, live locations and other unsupported attachments bypass Hold Messages and follow the normal send or schedule path; paid chats, disappearing messages and other special sends do too.

Covers hide chat name, sender, and message in app notifications. Tapping or dismissing a cover only clears that notification and never opens the chat. A cover has a Mark as read button but no reply, and with chat bubbles on it is usually a conversation under its persona name, which can appear in the conversation lists in Android settings. Attempting to open the real chat in the app clears its cover, even if unlock is cancelled or fails. Live incoming/ongoing call UI and stories remain outside disguise, while missed-call service notifications are covered generically. Android may still show the app as source, badges, and older pinned conversation/channel labels. Android notification settings and user-tuned channels stay authoritative.
